blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Markerless intraoperative tracking of spinal anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising alternative to invasive bone-anchored fiducials, yet no existing clinical dataset provides independent subsurface ground truth for validating these methods. We address this gap with a clinically viable pipeline that derives per-vertebra 6-DoF pose from routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, co-registered to the RGB-D camera frame through a multimodal fiducial array detectable in both imaging modalities. Critically, the pipeline requires no additional radiation, instrumentation, or deviation from standard surgical workflows, relying solely on the fluoroscopic images already acquired during routine level checks. A calibrated transform chain links the vertebral pose recovered via multi-view 2D-3D CT-to-fluoroscopy registration to the RGB-D coordinate frame, enabling direct comparison of any markerless registration estimate against a subsurface reference. Ex vivo validation against optically tracked ovine vertebrae confirms end-to-end accuracy of 2.06 +- 0.29 mm and 3.35 +- 0.93 degrees, sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for methods with substantially larger errors. We demonstrate the pipeline's utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data spanning 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames from three surgical sequences: the first such evaluation against an independent subsurface reference in a clinical setting. The proposed framework provides reusable infrastructure for benchmarking emerging markerless tracking methods on real surgical data.
blocks.zh: 通过RGB-D传感器对脊髓解剖学进行无标记的内行跟踪,是入侵性骨血管活化剂的一种有希望的替代品,然而,现有的临床数据集并没有为验证这些方法提供独立的地表下真伪. 我们用一条临床上可行的管线来弥补这一缺口,这条管线通过两种成像方式中都能探测到的多式微分阵列,从常规的操作内C-臂荧光镜中取出。 关键的是,管道不需要额外的辐射、仪器或偏离标准的外科手术工作流程,而只依靠在例行水平检查中已经获得的氟化图像。 将通过多视图2D-3D CT-对氟化物的登记与RGB-D坐标架所回收的脊椎造型连接起来,从而能够将任何无标记的登记估计数同地下参照物进行直接比较。 对光学跟踪的卵巢顶部进行外活性验证,证实端到端精度为2.06+-0.29毫米和3.35+-0.93度,足以作为具有明显较大误差的方法的独立地地真. 我们通过评价两个无标记的临床数据登记战略来展示管道的效用,这些战略跨越了三个外科序列的1 500个框架的11个脊椎:第一次这种评价是对照临床环境中的独立地表下参照进行的。 拟议框架为将新出现的无标记跟踪方法作为实际外科数据的基准提供了可重复使用的基础设施。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Motivation
blocks.zh: 1 导言和动机

blocks.en:
Markerless intraoperative tracking of orthopedic anatomy via RGB-D sensors is a promising emerging direction for surgical guidance [ 11 , 16 ] . Current surgical navigation systems depend on invasive bone-anchored fiducials to register (and subsequently track) preoperative imaging with the surgical scene [ 26 , 27 ] , introducing added operative time and complication risk [ 8 ] . Markerless approaches instead extract anatomically meaningful correspondences directly from intraoperative point clouds via learned segmentation, enabling registration and tracking without physical instrumentation [ 11 , 16 ] . Daly et al. [ 5 ] advanced this direction with the first clinical markerless tracking dataset for spine surgery. However, their ground truth is inherently approximate: alignment relies on surgeon-indicated surface landmarks refined against intraoperative topology, neither of which references the pose of the subsurface anatomy. For clinical adoption, markerless systems must be validated against a gold-standard measurement offering quantifiable translational and rotational error metrics [ 1 ] , a requirement no existing clinical dataset satisfies.
Cadaveric studies have obtained accurate vertebral pose through rigidly fixed optical tracking arrays [ 17 , 15 ] . Liebmann et al. [ 15 ] , for example, fixed 3D-printed constructs to vertebral bodies via K-wires, achieving sub-2 mm accuracy but requiring anterior exposure incompatible with standard posterior approaches, additional tracking hardware within the operative field, and an intraoperative CT. These requirements are not permissible within a clinical observational study, leaving a methodological gap: there is currently no clinically viable means of obtaining precise vertebral pose ground truth for evaluating markerless registration in real surgical settings.

通过RGB-D传感器对矫形解剖学进行无标记的手术内跟踪,是外科指导[11,16]的一个有希望的新兴方向. 目前的外科导航系统依靠入侵性骨血管纤维来对外科手术场景进行记录(并随后跟踪)术前成像[26,27],引入了额外的操作时间和并发症风险[8]. 无标记方法则通过学识分解直接从操作点云中提取解剖有意义的函文,从而可以在没有物理仪器的情况下进行登记和跟踪[11,16]. 达利等人. [5]通过第一个临床无标记跟踪数据集的脊椎手术推进这个方向. 然而,他们的地面真理本质上是近似的:校正依赖于外科医生指示的地表地标与内科地形相比得到完善,两者都未提及地下解剖学的姿势. 在临床上采用无标记系统时,必须参照提供可量化的翻译和旋转误差计量的金本位计量标准进行验证。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Capture
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据抓取

blocks.en: In contrast to the use of coarse surface features to approximate the underlying pose of the spine by Daly et al. [ 5 ] , we integrated routine intraoperative C-arm fluoroscopy, taken alongside the RGB-D recording, to locate the patient’s preoperative anatomy within the intraoperative scene. C-arm fluoroscopy is broadly accessible across clinical settings [ 3 , 19 ] , ensuring our pipeline generalizes across institutions without requiring intraoperative CT [ 14 ] . We used established multi-view 2D–3D registration algorithms, as implemented in the ImFusion software suite (ImFusion GmbH, Germany) [ 12 ] , requiring at least two fluoroscopic images from separate poses with known projection geometry.
blocks.zh: 与Daly等人使用粗糙的表面特征来近似脊椎的基本姿势形成对比. [5],我们整合了常规的手术内C臂含氟镜检查, 与RGB-D录制, 定位患者的手术前解剖 在内手术场景。 C-臂含氟镜可在临床环境中广泛获取[3,19],确保我们的管道跨机构通用,而无需操作内CT[14]。 我们使用了已建立的多视图 2D - 3D 注册算法,在ImFusion软件套件(ImFusion GmbH,德国)中实施 [12] ,其中要求至少从有已知的投影几何的单独的姿势中产生两个氟镜图像.

blocks.en: We modeled each C-arm source as a pinhole camera [ 23 , 10 , 18 ] and calibrated intrinsics using a custom multi-plane phantom [ 4 , 6 ] with nine radio-opaque ArUco markers [ 9 ] at known depths, estimating parameters via bundle adjustment [ 2 , 23 ] . Calibration images were acquired prior to surgery from AP and oblique angles within ±30°, reflecting the range of intraoperative C-arm positioning.
blocks.zh: 我们以针孔相机[23,10,18]为每个C-臂源的模型,并使用定制的多飞机幻象[4,6]进行校准,在已知的深度有9个射电孔的ArUco标记[9],通过捆绑调整估计参数[2,23]. 校准图像在手术前从 AP 和 oblique 角度在 ± 30 ° 内获得,反映了手术内C-臂定位的范围.

blocks.en: 2.2 Intraoperative Capture
blocks.zh: 2.2 非操作性捕捞

blocks.en:
This study received approval from the relevant national research
ethics authority (reference withheld for anonymization).
The cases we captured within our surgical study were taken from the clinical caseload of a tertiary neurosurgery department. The captured procedures are all lumbar-thoracic fixation cases. For recording RGB-D sequences, we used an Azure Kinect camera (Microsoft
Corporation, USA), positioned directly over the incision using a boom arm fixed to a tripod.

美国公司使用固定在三脚架上的爆臂,在切口上直接定位。

blocks.en:
To co-register fluoroscopic and RGB-D coordinate frames without external tracking hardware, we designed a multimodal fiducial array, automatically
detectable in both imaging modalities. Five radiopaque ArUco markers, each 30 × \times 30 mm, are inset on a radio-translucent PETG body. The insets were 3D-printed using PLA XRS filament (Nanovia Tech, France). The non-coplanar array layout ensured no marker overlap occurs at either AP or oblique viewing angles. The array was held on a boom arm adjacent to the exposition site, beneath the C-arm detector and within the RGB-D camera field of view, and covered with an ultrasound probe cover to maintain the sterile field.
blocks.zh:
为了共同登记氟化物和RGB-D坐标框架,没有外部跟踪硬件,我们设计了一个多模式微量阵列,自动
在两种成像模式中都能检测到. 5个射电帕ArUco标记,每个30×x\时30毫米,在一个射电透明PETG机体上被设置. 套装采用PLA XRS丝绸(法国纳诺维亚技术公司)3D印刷. 非coplanal阵列布局确保在AP或斜视角度上不发生标记重叠. 阵列被固定在靠近博览场的爆臂上,C臂探测器下方和RGB-D相机视场内,并被超声波探测器覆盖以维持无菌场.

blocks.en:
An intraoperative C-arm is routinely used to provide confirmation of the vertebra level being operated on, typically from an AP view with adjacent oblique views. As the marker array was adjacent to the exposition, it is visible in the X-ray field of view during these level check shots, allowing both the determination of relative C-arm pose and the co-registration of X-ray and RGB-D coordinate frames to be performed with the same array. For
each clinical case, we also collected the accompanying preoperative CT scan. We segmented the relevant bone tissue from CT using the network developed by Meng et al. [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh:
操作内C-臂通常用于确认所操作的脊椎关节,通常从具有相邻斜视的AP视图中得出。 由于标记阵列与展出相邻,因此在这些关卡检查镜头时在X射线视场中可见,因此既可以确定相对的C臂姿势,也可以将X射线和RGB-D坐标帧共同注册,使用相同的阵列进行. 对于
每个临床病例,我们也收集了 伴随的手术前CT扫描。 我们利用Meng等人开发的网络将相关骨组织从CT中分离出来. [21].

blocks.en: 2.3 CT Imaging to RGB-D Registration
blocks.zh: 2.3 CT 成像到 RGB-D 注册

blocks.en:
For each C-arm shot, using the acquired intrinsic parameters from our multi-view calibration, the radiopaque ArUco markers are automatically detected within the image, and we then recovered the board-to-detector transform via PnP pose estimation [ 7 , 13 ] . Designating the first acquired image as the reference frame, we computed relative transforms between shots through the common marker array coordinate system, and combined these with the previously calibrated intrinsic parameters to yield projection matrices suitable for multi-view 2D–3D registration.
Multi-view 2D-3D X-ray to CT registration is a well-established technique capable of achieving sub-millimeter accuracy [ 20 ] . We then performed intensity-based 2D–3D registration, optimizing over six rigid-body parameters by maximizing mutual information between digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) and the acquired fluoroscopic images, using the ImFusion software suite.
blocks.zh:
对于每个C-arm镜头,利用我们多视差校准中获得的内在参数,射电帕ArUco标记在图像中自动检测到,然后我们通过PnP恢复了棋盘对检测器的变换,形成估计[7,13]. 将第一个获得的图像指定为参考框架,我们通过共同标记阵列坐标系统计算出镜头之间的相对变换,并将这些变换与以前校准的内在参数结合起来,得出适合多视图2D-3D注册的投影矩阵.
多视图 2D-3D X射线到CT注册是一种公认的技术,能够达到子毫米的精确度[20]. 然后,我们进行了基于强度的2D-3D登记,利用ImFusion软件套件,优化了六个刚体参数,在数字重建的射电图(DRR)和获得的氟镜图像之间实现最大程度的相互信息。

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation and Results
blocks.zh: 3 评价和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Ex Vivo Validation
blocks.zh: 3.1 审定

blocks.en: To demonstrate the accuracy and repeatability of our data collection and labeling pipeline, we conducted several validation experiments. We first established the level of error introduced by each individual component of the transform chain. To do this, we first rigidly fixed a passive infrared tracking array to the multimodal marker array. We then directly compared how well the marker array itself could be tracked in both the C-arm imaging, as well as the Azure Kinect RGB frames, with respect to a highly accurate optical tracker (Polaris Vicra, Northern Digital Inc, Canada; 0.25 mm RMS volumetric accuracy, 0.50 mm 95% CI) [ 24 ] . For each imaging system, the marker array was moved between 4 4 distinct points in front of the sensor. We present the results in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了证明我们数据收集和标签管道的准确性和可重复性,我们进行了几次验证实验。 我们首先确定了变电链每个单个组成部分引入的错误程度。 为此,我们首先将一个被动红外跟踪阵列固定在多式联运标记阵列上。 然后,我们直接比较了C-臂成像和Azure Kinect RGB帧中可追踪到的标记阵列本身在高度精确的光学跟踪器(Polaris Vicra, Northern Digital Inc;0.25毫米RMS体积精度,0.50毫米95%CI)[24]。 对于每个成像系统,标记阵列被移动到传感器前的4个不同点之间. 我们在Tab中介绍结果。 1 (英语).

blocks.en: Subsequently, to validate the end-to-end accuracy of the full transform chain, we compared the difference in pose of four excised ovine vertebrae determined by our pipeline, with that found by directly tracking ArUco markers, rigidly fixed to the vertebrae. We mounted two plastic ArUco markers to each of the vertebrae with plastic screws, minimizing the markers’ visibility within the C-arm imaging. We then performed CT scans of each vertebra. Within the coordinate space of the generated scans, we then localized the ArUco positions, meaning then that each vertebra could be tracked directly via the RGB-D camera, by-passing the transform chain shown in Fig. 1 (I) entirely.
blocks.zh: 随后,为了验证全变形链的端到端精度,我们比较了我们输油管确定的4个切开的卵巢椎的姿势差异,与直接跟踪ArUco标记而发现的,刚性固定在椎骨上的差异. 我们用塑料螺丝将两个塑料ArUco标记安装到每个脊椎上,将标记在C臂成像中的能见度降到最低。 然后对每个椎骨进行CT扫描. 在生成的扫描的坐标空间内,我们然后对ArUco位置进行本地化,这意味着每个顶点都可以通过RGB-D相机直接跟踪,绕过图1(I)中显示的变换链.

blocks.en:
To compute registration differences, we selected two points (the tip of the spinous process, and a point on the superior laminar margin) for establishing a Total Registration Error (TRE), with the optically tracked pose representing the target.
The vertebrae and radio-opaque marker array were positioned between the source and detector of a TAU 2020 C-arm (Ziehm-Orthoscan Inc, USA), as described in section 2.2 . With the radio-opaque marker array visible from the RGB-D camera, we captured 2 C-arm shots with an angular disparity of 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} . This is comparable to the mean angular disparity of 25.6 ∘ 25.6^{\circ} seen in clinical cases we captured. Following the process described in 2.3 , we projected the vertebrae from the CT coordinate space to the RGB-D camera coordinate space.
We present the TRE for the point landmarks as well as the rotational difference in Tab. 2 .

blocks.en: The independent validation of the RGB-D and X-ray pose tracking against an optical tracker reference confirms sub-millimeter translational agreement and sub-degree rotational agreement. The end-to-end pipeline, validated ex vivo against fiducial-tracked vertebral pose, yields a combined TRE of 2.06 ± 0.29 2.06\pm 0.29 mm and rotational error of 3.35 ± 0.93 ∘ 3.35\pm 0.93^{\circ} , approaching the ≤ 2 \leq 2 mm and ≤ 5 ∘ \leq 5^{\circ} thresholds commonly cited for spinal navigation systems [ 22 ] . Critically, this level of precision is sufficient to serve as independent ground truth for evaluating markerless tracking methods, whose registration errors are substantially larger, particularly in rotation.
blocks.zh: 对RGB-D和X射线的独立验证对光学跟踪器的参照,证实了子毫米翻译协议和子度旋转协议. 末端至末端管道,经验证后外向抗导的脊椎造型,其TRE值为2.06±0.292.06\pm0.29毫米,旋转误差为3.35±0.93±3.35\pm 0.93\circ},接近脊椎导航系统通常引用的2\leq 2mm和5\\\\\crc}阈值[22]. 关键的是,这种精确度足以成为评价无标记跟踪方法的独立地面真相,其登记错误,特别是轮换错误要大得多。

blocks.en: 3.2 Clinical Data Registration
blocks.zh: 3.2 临床数据登记

blocks.en: With the pipeline validated in the lab, we demonstrated its utility by evaluating two markerless registration strategies on clinical data from three surgical sequences, encompassing 11 vertebrae across 1,500 frames. To our knowledge, this represents the first evaluation of markerless spine registration against an independent subsurface gold standard reference in a clinical setting.
blocks.zh: 随着管道在实验室的验证,我们通过评估三个外科手术序列的临床数据上的两个无标记登记战略,包括1 500帧的11个椎骨,证明了其效用。 据我们所知,这是首次对照临床环境下独立的地下金本位标准参照标准,对无标记脊椎登记进行评价。

blocks.en: The first strategy follows [ 5 ] , deforming the preoperative spine mesh via a kinematic chain model before rigidly registering it to segmented intraoperative points using ICP. This approach relies on semi-automated surface-based optimization of the kinematic chain parameters, with manual refinement, to align the deformed mesh with the intraoperative point cloud: a workflow difficult to scale to real-time intraoperative use. We therefore additionally trialed a fully automated approach inspired by [ 16 ] , in which CT meshes of individual vertebrae are independently registered to per-vertebra segmentation patches. These patches were obtained via a two-stage pipeline: a PointNet++ [ 25 ] heatmap regression network, trained on manually annotated spinous process tip positions, first localizes tips within the point cloud (recall 0.95, F1 0.89, localization error 3.98 ± 1.99 3.98\pm 1.99 mm), after which a PointNet segmentation network isolates points within 40 mm of each detection (IoU 0.71, F1 0.83). Per-vertebra segmentation labels were generated by computing mesh-to-point-cloud proximity for individual vertebral CT meshes from [ 5 ] , following the same approach used therein for global spine masks. The results of both registration approaches, evaluated against our fluoroscopic pose estimates with a correspondence distance of 3 mm for both methods, are shown in Tab. 3 .
blocks.zh: 第一个战略遵循[5],通过动脉链模型使手术前的脊椎网变形,然后用国际比较方案将其严格登记为分解术内点。 这种方法依赖于半自动地表优化动脉链参数,并进行人工改进,使变形网格与操作内点云一致:一个工作流程难以缩放到实时操作内使用. 因此,我们额外尝试了一种受[16]启发的完全自动化的方法,其中单个椎骨的CT meshes被独立注册到每个椎骨分块补丁. 这些补丁是通过两个阶段的管道获得的:一个PointNet++[25]热映射回归网络,在人工附加说明的自旋过程尖端位置上训练,首先在点云内定位小费(召回0.95,F10.89,局部化错误3.98±1.99 3.98\pm 1.99mm),之后一个PointNet分割网络在每次探测40毫米范围内隔离点(IoU 0.71,F1 0.83). 通过计算单个脊椎CT网膜的网间距,从[5]产生每个脊椎分化标签,其方法与全球脊椎口罩相同。 根据我们的氟度评估的两种登记方法的结果,对这两种方法的对应距离为3毫米的估算结果,见Tab。 页:1

blocks.en: The rigid method of [ 5 ] outperforms per-vertebra ICP on rotation ( 4.52 ∘ ± 1.00 ∘ 4.52^{\circ}\pm 1.00^{\circ} vs. 8.36 ∘ ± 3.69 ∘ 8.36^{\circ}\pm 3.69^{\circ} ) and exhibits substantially lower variance across all metrics, while mean translation errors are comparable with overlapping distributions. The per-vertebra approach, though fully automated, lacks the geometric constraints afforded by registering the full spine as a single structure, limiting its ability to resolve orientation. While both methods achieve mean translational errors below 5 mm, neither yet meets the ≤ 2 \leq 2 mm and ≤ 5 ∘ \leq 5^{\circ} thresholds cited for spinal navigation [ 22 ] , underscoring both the value of independent pose evaluation and the headroom remaining for emerging methods.
blocks.zh: 硬性方法[5]在旋转时优于每个脊椎的ICP(4.52 ± 1.00 ± 4.52 + + + + + + + + + + + + = 4.52 + + + + + pm 1.00=circ}对8.36= 3.69= 8.36=circ}\pm 3.69-circ}),并显示所有衡量标准的差异要小得多,而平均翻译错误与重叠的分布可比较。 纵椎法虽然完全自动化,但缺乏通过将全脊作为单一结构登记而提供的几何限制,限制了其解决定向问题的能力。 虽然这两种方法都达到了5毫米以下的平均翻译误差,但还没有达到脊椎导航所引用的“2 \leq 2 毫米”和“5 \ \leq 5\circ ” 阈值,这既强调了独立评价的价值,也强调了用于新兴方法的会议室。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The clinical registration comparison in Tab. 3 demonstrates the core contribution of this work: for the first time, competing markerless registration strategies can be evaluated on real surgical data against an independent subsurface reference. Prior clinical evaluation was limited to surrogate surface metrics [ 5 ] ; our pipeline provides per-vertebra 6-DoF pose estimates from routine intraoperative fluoroscopy without additional hardware or workflow disruption.
blocks.zh: Tab. 3中的临床登记比较显示了这项工作的核心贡献:第一次可以对照独立的地下参考,对真正的外科数据进行无标记登记战略评价。 之前的临床评价仅限于替代表面度量衡[5];我们的输油管提供每椎6-DoF的常规操作内含氟体镜的估算,而不增加硬件或工作流程中断.

blocks.en: Registration errors in Tab. 3 are measured against our fluoroscopic estimates, which carry an intrinsic uncertainty of 2.06 ± 0.29 2.06\pm 0.29 mm and 3.35 ± 0.93 ∘ 3.35\pm 0.93^{\circ} (Tab. 2 ); these values thus represent upper bounds on true registration error. Alas, the rotational difference between the two methods ( 3.84 ∘ 3.84^{\circ} ) exceeds our reference uncertainty, confirming that the rigid method of [ 5 ] is meaningfully more accurate in rotation. Translational errors are not statistically different. Overall, the rigid approach is clearly superior, but its reliance on manual deformation tuning remains a barrier to clinical deployment, and thus an avenue for future work.
blocks.zh: Tab的注册错误. 3 与我们的含氟量估计值(含2.06 ± 0.29 2.06\pm 0.29毫米和3.35 ± 0.93 ± 3.35\pm 0.93\circ})进行测量;因此,这些数值代表了真实登记错误的上限。 唉,两种方法(3.84 ∘ 3.84 ^{\circ})的旋转差异超过了我们的参考不确定性,证实了[5]的刚性方法在旋转中更有意义地准确. 翻译错误在统计学上并无不同. 总体而言,僵硬的方法显然优越,但其依赖人工变形调理仍然是临床部署的障碍,因此是未来工作的一条途径.

blocks.en: Key limitations remain. The study reports three clinical sequences and ovine ex vivo validation; further labeled cases, drawn from a larger ongoing clinical study, will broaden the evaluation. Accuracy is also constrained by the 2D–3D registration stage, which depends on image quality, angular separation, and the number of fluoroscopic views.
blocks.zh: 关键限制依然存在。 该研究报告了三个临床序列和卵巢外阴鉴定;从一个更大的正在进行的临床研究中抽取的进一步标注病例将扩大评价范围. 准确性还受到2D-3D注册阶段的限制,该阶段取决于图像质量、角分离和氟镜视图的数量。

blocks.en: Clinically, classical surface registration is intrinsically limited: the posterior vertebral surface exposed during surgery is geometrically ambiguous, leaving ICP unable to robustly resolve pose, particularly rotation. This is unlikely to improve with initialization alone. With sufficient fluoroscopic ground truth, a learned mapping from intraoperative point clouds to vertebral pose could instead leverage appearance, anatomical context, and priors beyond ICP’s scope.
blocks.zh: 在临床上,古典的表层登记是内在有限的:手术期间暴露的后脊椎表面几何模糊,使得比较方案无法有力解决姿势,特别是旋转. 单靠初始化是不可能改进的。 有了足够的含氟度地面真理,从操作内点云到脊椎构造学成的绘图就能够利用外观、解剖背景和超出国际比较方案范围的前身。
